workflow_metadata.name: Deployment Environment Specification
workflow_metadata.description: Define operational/deployment environment BEFORE development begins - understand WHERE and HOW the system will run
workflow_metadata.purpose: Capture deployment environment requirements upfront to inform development decisions and prevent late-stage deployment surprises
workflow_metadata.when_to_use: After architecture/visualization (02) and BEFORE development implementation (03a)
workflow_metadata.key_insight: Understanding the deployment environment (containerization, scaling, security, observability) should inform development decisions, not be discovered during deployment
workflow_metadata.trigger_command: Implement workflow in /path/to/reflow/workflows/02b-deployment_environment.json on system in /path/to/your_system
workflow_metadata.typical_duration: 1-2 hours for initial spec, 30 min for updates

quick.description: Minimal deployment spec for simple systems

workflow_steps.name: Deployment Environment Specification
workflow_steps.description: Define the operational/deployment context for the system - WHERE and HOW it will run
workflow_steps.rationale: Understanding deployment environment upfront prevents costly rework when deployment constraints are discovered late

actions.purpose: Know WHERE the system will run before writing code
questions: What is the primary deployment target? (cloud provider, on-premises, hybrid, edge)
Which cloud provider(s)? (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.)
What environments are needed? (dev, staging, production)
Any air-gapped or restricted network requirements?

actions.purpose: Inform service packaging and dependency management decisions
questions: Will services be containerized? (Docker, containerd, etc.)
What orchestration platform? (Kubernetes, ECS, Docker Swarm, none)

actions.purpose: Design for scale from the start, not as an afterthought
questions: Auto-scaling triggers? (CPU, memory, queue depth, custom metrics)
Any services that must be singleton?

actions.purpose: Design security in, not bolt it on later
questions: Network policies required? (ingress/egress rules, service mesh)
Secrets management approach? (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, K8s secrets)
TLS requirements? (mTLS between services, certificate management)

actions.purpose: Plan for operations from the start - logging, metrics, tracing, alerting
questions: Logging format and aggregation? (JSON, structured, ELK, CloudWatch, Datadog)

actions.purpose: Identify all external systems the service depends on
questions: Databases required? (type, managed vs self-hosted, HA requirements)

instructions: Fill in all sections from A01-A06 analysis

actions.purpose: Ensure spec is actionable before proceeding to development
validation_checks: All required sections populated (no empty objects)
Security requirements compatible with target platform
Observability requirements achievable with chosen stack
actions.on_failure: Return to relevant A01-A06 action to fill gaps

gates.name: Deployment Environment Specified
checks: deployment_environment_spec.json exists and is valid JSON
All required sections have content (not empty/TBD)
Containerization strategy is defined OR explicitly marked as 'none'
At least basic scaling requirements documented
gates.failure_action: Cannot proceed to development without deployment environment spec

workflow_steps.name: Deployment Environment Validation & Integration
workflow_steps.description: Validate deployment spec against architecture and update relevant files

actions.purpose: Ensure deployment spec aligns with service architecture
checks: All services in architecture have deployment considerations
Security model compatible with service communication patterns

actions.purpose: No missing dependencies that will block development
checks: All databases/caches required by services are listed
All external APIs are documented with connection details
All message queues/event buses are specified

actions.description: Check security requirements against compliance frameworks
actions.purpose: Ensure security approach meets compliance needs
actions.conditional: Only if compliance_frameworks specified in DE-01-A04
checks: Access control model supports compliance requirements

actions.purpose: Ensure architecture files reflect deployment decisions
updates: Add/update deployment_architecture section in each service_architecture.json

gates.name: Deployment Environment Validated
checks: Deployment spec consistent with service architecture

required: deployment_environment_spec.json created with all required sections

success_criteria.primary: Development team knows WHERE and HOW the system will run before writing code
success_criteria.secondary: Infrastructure team can begin provisioning while development proceeds
success_criteria.tertiary: No deployment surprises during implementation or testing phases

references.03a-development_implementation: D-01-A01 should reference deployment_environment_spec.json for language/framework decisions
references.04a-testing: Uses deployment spec for test environment setup
references.04b-operations: Uses deployment spec for production deployment

key_questions: Ask the user early: 'Where will this system be deployed?' before making any development decisions
If user says 'I don't know yet', prompt for at least: cloud vs on-prem, containerized vs not, any compliance requirements
Don't assume Docker/Kubernetes - some systems run bare metal, serverless, or on edge devices
anti_patterns: Don't skip this workflow assuming 'we'll figure out deployment later'
Don't assume all services have the same deployment requirements
Don't over-engineer for scale you don't need yet (but document growth path)
Don't ignore security/compliance until the end
